name: Foundation Utility
description: A text-format filter that adds Zurb Foundation CSS classes to tables and strips width/height/style attributes for responsive display.
project_description:
Utility module to provide several helpful ZURB Foundation helpers.

See the submodules descriptions below.

 Back to top 

 Submodules: 
 ZURB Foundation Utility Filters 
 Provides the following Drupal Input Filters:

 
 Option to add .hover class to table ( https://get.foundation/sites/docs/table.html#hover-state ) 
 Option to add .unstriped class to table ( https://get.foundation/sites/docs/table.html#stripes ) 
 Option to add .stacked class to table ( https://get.foundation/sites/docs/table.html#stacked-table ) 
 Option to add .scroll class to table ( https://get.foundation/sites/docs/table.html#scrolling-table ) 
 Option to remove width and height attributes from table & cells 
 
 Further utility submodules or functionality might be added in the future! :)

Feel free to fill an issue for ideas.
